description: This file defines the DataSet class within the Goteo project, representing a data entity with properties such as id, title, description, type, language, URL, image, and timestamps. It includes methods for getting and setting these properties, as well as retrieving related images.

classes.name: DataSet
classes.description: A data entity class representing a dataset with attributes like title, description, type, language, URL, image, and timestamps. It provides getter and setter methods for managing its properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the language property from the configuration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the dataset.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the dataset.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the dataset.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the dataset.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the dataset.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the dataset.

methods.name: getLang
methods.description: Returns the language of the dataset.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getModifiedAt
methods.description: Returns the modification timestamp as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Image object, either directly or via a static get method.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Associates an Image object with the dataset.
